large_scope_reason: The owner selected editing a sent message into a preserved child conversation branch after accepted Conversation Graph closeout PR #274. One bounded slice extends the existing Graph membership, branch-local selections and request admission, its current chat UI, additive contracts, forward migration and fake-provider tests. Backend owns nineteen paths, frontend fifteen and the controller/workflow six; canonical documentation setup is serialized before those product writers. Existing shared domains, physical message history, immutable source records, provider lifecycle and all prior checkpoints remain owned by their existing modules. Forty is the unchanged hard limit, not permission to hide files or weaken required tests.
non_goals: No second Chat backend, Graph rewrite, attachment editor, branch rename/archive/delete or general Context Engine
No actual paid provider call, production deployment, protected-main push, future PR merge, force-push or CI/protection bypass
No manual state/checkpoint mutation, downgrade of complete Graph, transfer of owner waiver, fake execution request or lost original history
No scope/size limit increase, hidden generated source, shortened coverage for a passing gate or changes to shared auth/credits/media authority
